name: Family Favourites (Germany)
summary: The 50 dishes German families most like to cook on weekdays.

recipes.name: Spaghetti bolognese
steps: Finely dice the onion, garlic and carrot.
Brown the mince in the oil until crumbly, add the vegetables and fry briefly.
Stir in the tomato purée, add the tomatoes and oregano and simmer gently for 20 minutes.
Cook the spaghetti in salted water until al dente.
Season the sauce with salt and pepper and serve with the spaghetti and Parmesan.

recipes.name: Rindergulasch (German beef goulash)
steps: Roughly dice the onions and cut the pepper into pieces.
Brown the meat well in the clarified butter in batches.
Add the onions and fry, then briefly toast the tomato purée and paprika.
Deglaze with the stock, add the bay leaf and marjoram and braise, covered, for about 90 minutes.
Add the pepper for the last 20 minutes and boil the potatoes.
Season the goulash and serve with boiled potatoes.

recipes.name: Rinderrouladen (rolled braised beef)
steps: Lay the beef slices out flat, season with salt and pepper and spread with mustard.
Top with bacon, gherkin strips and onion strips, roll up and secure with cocktail sticks.
Brown the rolls all over in the clarified butter and briefly toast the tomato purée with them.
Deglaze with the stock and braise, covered, for about 90 minutes.
Boil the potatoes and warm the red cabbage.
Thicken the sauce with the cornflour mixed with a little water and serve everything together.

recipes.name: Chilli con carne
steps: Finely dice the onion and garlic.
Brown the mince until crumbly, then add the onion and garlic.
Stir in the tomato purée and spices, then add the tomatoes and stock.
Add the rinsed beans and the sweetcorn and simmer for 15 minutes.
Cook the rice according to the packet instructions and serve the chilli with a dollop of soured cream.

recipes.name: Lasagne
steps: Brown the mince with the onion and garlic, add the tomatoes and oregano and simmer for 15 minutes.
For the béchamel, melt the butter, stir in the flour, pour in the milk and bring to the boil. Season with nutmeg, salt and pepper.
Layer the sauces and lasagne sheets alternately in an ovenproof dish, finishing with béchamel.
Sprinkle with mozzarella and Parmesan.
Bake at 180°C fan for about 40 minutes and leave to rest briefly.

recipes.name: Beef mince tacos
steps: Dice the onion and garlic and fry the mince in them until crumbly.
Add the spices, passata, beans and sweetcorn and let reduce for 10 minutes.
Shred the lettuce and dice the tomatoes.
Warm the taco shells briefly in the oven.
Put everything on the table – everyone fills their own tacos.

recipes.name: Hamburgers
steps: Knead the mince with the egg, breadcrumbs, mustard, salt and pepper and shape into 4 flat patties.
Slice the tomatoes, onion and gherkins.
Fry the patties in a frying pan for about 4 minutes on each side.
Halve the buns and toast them briefly.
Fill the buns with sauces, lettuce, a patty and the vegetables.

recipes.name: Stuffed peppers
steps: Part-cook the rice. Halve and deseed the peppers.
Mix the mince with the rice, diced onion, egg, paprika, salt and pepper.
Fill the pepper halves with the mixture and place them in an ovenproof dish.
Stir the passata together with the stock and tomato purée and pour it around the peppers.
Cook at 180°C for about 40 minutes. Finish the sauce with soured cream.

recipes.name: Hackbraten (German meatloaf)
steps: Soak the bread roll and squeeze it out, finely dice the onions and chop the parsley.
Knead the mince with the bread roll, onions, eggs, mustard, parsley and spices.
Shape into a loaf and place in an ovenproof dish.
Bake at 180°C for about 50 minutes, adding the stock after 20 minutes.
Boil the potatoes. Stir the pan juices with the cream to make a sauce and serve everything together.

recipes.name: Cheese and leek soup with mince
steps: Slice the leeks into rings and wash thoroughly, dice the onion.
Brown the mince in the oil until crumbly and add the onion.
Sweat the leeks briefly, add the stock and simmer for 15 minutes.
Stir in the processed cheese until melted.
Season with salt, pepper and nutmeg and serve with baguette.

recipes.name: Cevapcici (Balkan grilled mince rolls) with rice and salad
steps: Chop the onion and garlic very finely.
Knead the mince with the onion, garlic, ajvar, breadcrumbs and spices.
Shape into finger-length rolls and fry in a frying pan for about 10 minutes, turning all over.
Cook the rice and stir in a little ajvar and the vegetables.
Chop the cucumber and tomatoes into a salad and serve everything with tzatziki.

recipes.name: Schnitzel with fried potatoes
steps: Boil the potatoes in their skins, leave to cool, peel and slice.
Thinly slice the cucumber and mix with the soured cream, dill, salt and pepper to make cucumber salad.
Fry the potatoes with diced onion in clarified butter until golden brown.
Pound the escalopes thin, season and coat in flour, then egg, then breadcrumbs.
Fry the schnitzels in plenty of clarified butter for 3 minutes on each side until golden brown.
Serve with the fried potatoes, cucumber salad and lemon wedges.

recipes.name: Currywurst (sausage in curry ketchup sauce) with chips
steps: Bake the chips in the oven according to the packet instructions.
Finely dice the onion and sweat in the oil until translucent, then briefly toast the curry powder and sugar.
Add the tomato purée, orange juice and passata and simmer for 10 minutes, then blend and season.
Fry the bratwursts in a frying pan until browned all over and cut into pieces.
Pour the sauce over the sausage, dust with curry powder and serve with the chips.

recipes.name: Bratwurst with sauerkraut and mashed potato
steps: Peel the potatoes and boil in salted water for about 20 minutes until tender.
Dice the onion, sweat in a little butter, add the sauerkraut and apple juice and simmer for 15 minutes.
Drain the potatoes, mash with warm milk and butter and season with nutmeg.
Fry the bratwursts in a frying pan until golden brown all over.
Arrange everything together on plates.

recipes.name: Linsen mit Spätzle (Swabian lentils with egg noodles and sausages)
steps: Finely dice the onion, carrot and celeriac.
Render the bacon in a saucepan and briefly sweat the vegetables with it.
Add the lentils and stock and simmer for about 30 minutes until tender.
Season with vinegar, sugar, salt and pepper to a sweet-and-sour taste.
Heat the sausages in the lentils, prepare the spätzle according to the packet instructions and serve alongside.

recipes.name: Erbseneintopf (split pea stew) with Kassler
ingredients: 1 bunch soup vegetables (carrot, celeriac, leek, parsley)
steps: Dice the onion and chop the soup vegetables and potatoes into small pieces.
Sweat the onion in the oil, add the peas and stock and simmer for 20 minutes.
Add the potatoes, soup vegetables and marjoram and cook for a further 20 minutes.
Dice the Kassler and heat it in the stew for the last 10 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper and serve with bread.

recipes.name: Potato soup with sausages
ingredients: 4 Frankfurter sausages or 2 Bockwurst (large Frankfurter-style sausages)
steps: Peel and dice the potatoes and carrots, chop the onion.
Sweat the onion in the oil, add the vegetables and pour in the stock.
Cook with the marjoram for about 20 minutes until tender, then roughly mash or partly blend.
Slice the sausages and heat them in the soup.
Season, sprinkle with parsley and serve with bread.

recipes.name: Potato bake with ham
steps: Peel the potatoes, slice them thinly and dice the ham.
Butter an ovenproof dish and layer in the potatoes, ham and diced onion.
Whisk the cream, milk and eggs, season with nutmeg, salt and pepper and pour over.
Sprinkle with cheese and bake at 180°C for about 45 minutes until golden brown.
Serve with a green salad.

recipes.name: Schinkennudeln (pasta with ham and egg)
steps: Cook the pasta in salted water until al dente and drain.
Dice the ham and onion and fry in butter.
Add the pasta and fry briefly.
Whisk the eggs with the milk, cheese, salt and pepper, pour over and stir until set.
Sprinkle with chives and serve with salad.

recipes.name: Tortellini bake
steps: Preheat the oven to 200°C. Dice the pepper, onion and ham.
Put the tortellini in an ovenproof dish with the vegetables, ham, peas and sweetcorn.
Stir the milk and cream together with salt and pepper and pour over.
Sprinkle with cheese and bake for about 20 minutes until golden.

recipes.name: Geschnetzeltes (creamy sliced pork with mushrooms) with rice
steps: Cook the rice according to the packet instructions.
Cut the meat into thin strips, dice the shallots and garlic and slice the mushrooms.
Sear the meat in batches in hot oil and remove from the pan.
Sweat the shallots, garlic and mushrooms in butter, dust with flour and pour in the stock and cream.
Return the meat to the sauce, let it heat through briefly, season and serve with parsley and rice.

recipes.name: Gyros with tzatziki
steps: Cut the meat into thin strips and mix with the gyros seasoning and 2 tbsp oil.
For the tzatziki, grate half the cucumber, squeeze it out and mix with the yoghurt, garlic and salt.
Cook the rice. Chop the remaining cucumber and the tomatoes into a salad.
Fry the meat in batches in a hot frying pan until crisp, frying sliced onion with it.
Serve the gyros with rice, salad and tzatziki.

recipes.name: Spaghetti carbonara
steps: Cook the spaghetti in plenty of salted water until al dente.
Fry the bacon in the oil until crisp.
Whisk the eggs with the Parmesan and pepper.
Drain the pasta, reserving a little cooking water, and immediately mix with the bacon.
Take the pan off the heat, stir in the egg mixture and a little cooking water until creamy, and serve straight away.

recipes.name: Flammkuchen (Alsatian thin-crust tart with bacon and onion)
ingredients: 200 g Schmand (German soured cream, or full-fat soured cream)
steps: Preheat the oven to 220°C (conventional, top and bottom heat).
Stir the Schmand and crème fraîche together and season with nutmeg, salt and pepper.
Roll the dough out onto baking trays and spread thinly with the cream mixture.
Slice the onions into thin rings and scatter over with the bacon.
Bake for about 12–15 minutes until crisp and serve with salad.

recipes.name: Frikadellen (German meat patties) with potato salad
ingredients: 600 g mixed beef and pork mince
1 gherkin with 4 tbsp gherkin pickling liquid
steps: Boil the potatoes, peel and slice them, and dress with the diced gherkin, pickling liquid and mayonnaise.
Soak the bread roll and squeeze it out well, finely dice the onion.
Knead the mince with the bread roll, onion, egg, mustard, parsley, salt and pepper.
Shape into 8 flat patties.
Fry in clarified butter for 5–6 minutes on each side and serve with the potato salad.

recipes.name: Königsberger Klopse (meatballs in caper sauce)
ingredients: 600 g mixed beef and pork mince
steps: Knead the mince with the finely chopped onion, egg, breadcrumbs, salt and pepper and shape into 12 meatballs.
Bring the stock to the boil with the bay leaf, poach the meatballs in it for about 15 minutes and remove.
Boil the potatoes.
Melt the butter, stir in the flour and add about 600 ml of the stock. Add the cream, capers and lemon juice.
Warm the meatballs in the sauce and serve with boiled potatoes.

recipes.name: Chicken fricassee with rice
steps: Cook the rice according to the packet instructions.
Cut the chicken into pieces, poach in the stock for about 10 minutes and remove.
Chop the onion, carrot and mushrooms and sweat in butter.
Stir in the flour, gradually add the stock and bring to the boil.
Add the cream, peas and chicken, season with lemon juice, salt and pepper and serve with rice.

recipes.name: Chicken nuggets with oven-roasted potatoes
steps: Preheat the oven to 200°C. Cut the potatoes into wedges, toss with oil and salt and bake for about 35 minutes.
Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and season with paprika, salt and pepper.
Crush the cornflakes in a bag.
Coat the chicken in flour, then beaten egg, then cornflakes.
Place the nuggets on a baking tray and bake alongside for the last 15–20 minutes. Serve with ketchup and raw vegetable sticks.

recipes.name: Chicken in creamy pepper sauce
steps: Cook the rice according to the packet instructions.
Cut the chicken into strips and the peppers and onion into pieces.
Brown the chicken all over in the oil, season with salt and pepper and remove.
Sweat the peppers, onion and garlic, stir in the paprika and deglaze with the cream and stock.
Return the chicken, simmer for 5 minutes and serve with rice.

recipes.name: Butter chicken
steps: Dice the chicken and mix with the yoghurt, 1 tsp garam masala and salt.
Cook the rice. Finely chop the onion, garlic and ginger.
Sweat the onion, garlic and ginger in butter and briefly toast the remaining spices.
Add the passata and simmer for 10 minutes, then stir in the cream.
Add the chicken with its marinade and cook in the sauce for about 10 minutes. Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Chicken and vegetable stir-fry
steps: Cook the rice according to the packet instructions.
Cut the chicken into strips and the vegetables into bite-sized pieces.
Brown the chicken all over in the oil and remove.
Fry the vegetables in the pan for 5 minutes, then add the rinsed chickpeas.
Deglaze with the stock and soy sauce, return the chicken, toss briefly and serve with rice.

recipes.name: Chicken fajitas
ingredients: 150 g Schmand (German soured cream, or full-fat soured cream)
steps: Cut the chicken, peppers and onion into strips.
Mix the chicken with the oil, spices, garlic and a little lime juice.
Fry the chicken in a hot frying pan, add the peppers and onion and fry for 5–6 minutes more.
Mash the avocado with lime juice and salt, and warm the tortillas briefly.
Put everything on the table and let everyone fill their own tortillas.

recipes.name: Traybake chicken legs
steps: Preheat the oven to 200°C.
Halve the potatoes, cut the vegetables into large pieces and toss on a baking tray with 2 tbsp oil, the rosemary and salt.
Rub the chicken legs with the remaining oil, paprika, salt and pepper.
Lay the chicken legs on top of the vegetables.
Bake for about 45–50 minutes until the skin is crisp and the meat is cooked through.

recipes.name: Chicken pasta bake
steps: Preheat the oven to 180°C. Cook the pasta for 2 minutes less than the packet says.
Dice the chicken and fry in the oil, then briefly fry the diced pepper and onion with it.
Mix the pasta, chicken, vegetables and peas in an ovenproof dish.
Whisk the cream, milk and eggs, season and pour over.
Sprinkle with cheese and bake for about 25 minutes until golden brown.

recipes.name: Chicken noodle soup
ingredients: 1 bunch soup vegetables (carrot, celeriac, leek, parsley)
steps: Put the chicken legs in cold water with the halved onion, the bay leaf and 1 tsp salt.
Bring to the boil and simmer gently for about 60 minutes, skimming off any scum.
Remove the chicken, take the meat off the skin and bones and shred it.
Chop the soup vegetables and cook in the stock for 10 minutes, then add the noodles and cook until done.
Return the meat to the soup, season and sprinkle with parsley.

recipes.name: Baked chicken breast with mushrooms
steps: Preheat the oven to 200°C. Season the chicken with salt and pepper, sear briefly and place in an ovenproof dish.
Fry the mushrooms, onion and garlic in butter and dust with flour.
Pour in the cream and milk, bring to the boil and season.
Pour the mushroom sauce over the chicken, sprinkle with cheese and bake for about 20 minutes until golden.
Cook the pasta and serve alongside.

recipes.name: Fish fingers with potato and carrot mash
steps: Peel and dice the potatoes and carrots and boil in salted water for about 20 minutes until tender.
Fry the fish fingers in the oil for 3–4 minutes on each side until golden brown.
Drain the vegetables and roughly mash with warm milk and butter.
Season with nutmeg, salt and pepper.
Serve the mash with the fish fingers and sprinkle with parsley.

recipes.name: Salmon pasta with broccoli
steps: Cook the pasta in salted water, adding the broccoli florets for the last 4 minutes.
Dice the salmon and finely chop the shallot.
Sweat the shallot in butter, pour in the cream and bring briefly to the boil.
Add the salmon to the sauce and poach for 3–4 minutes, then season with lemon zest and juice.
Drain the pasta and broccoli, mix with the sauce and sprinkle with chives.

recipes.name: Oven-baked salmon with potatoes and vegetables
steps: Preheat the oven to 200°C. Halve the potatoes, put them on a baking tray with 2 tbsp oil and salt and pre-bake for 15 minutes.
Slice the carrots and courgette, add to the potatoes with the remaining oil and bake for a further 10 minutes.
Season the salmon with salt and pepper and lay it on the vegetables.
Bake for about 15 minutes until the salmon is cooked.
Stir the crème fraîche with the dill, lemon juice and salt and serve alongside.

recipes.name: Plaice fillets with pea and potato mash
steps: Peel the potatoes and boil in salted water for about 20 minutes, adding the peas for the last 5 minutes.
Drain, mash with warm milk and butter and season.
Season the fish fillets with salt and pepper and coat in flour.
Fry in the oil for 2–3 minutes on each side until golden brown.
Serve the fish with the mash and lemon wedges.

recipes.name: Fish fillet with vegetable rice
steps: Cook the rice according to the packet instructions.
Cut the broccoli into florets and cook gently with the frozen vegetables in 1 tbsp butter for about 8 minutes.
Mix the vegetables into the rice and season.
Season the fish with salt and pepper, coat in flour and fry on both sides in the oil and remaining butter.
Serve the fish on the vegetable rice with lemon wedges.

recipes.name: Penne with tuna and tomato sauce
ingredients: 2 tins tuna in spring water (150 g each)
steps: Cook the penne in salted water until al dente.
Dice the onion and garlic and sweat in the oil.
Add the tomatoes and oregano and simmer for 10 minutes.
Drain the tuna, flake it and warm it in the sauce, then season.
Mix with the pasta and sprinkle with spring onions and Parmesan.

recipes.name: Käsespätzle (cheese egg noodles with crispy onions)
ingredients: 250 g Bergkäse (Alpine mountain cheese) or Emmental, grated
steps: Beat the flour, eggs, water and 1 tsp salt to a thick, elastic batter and leave to rest for 10 minutes.
Slice the onions into rings and fry slowly in 2 tbsp butter until golden brown.
Press the batter in batches through a spätzle press into boiling salted water and lift out as soon as the spätzle float to the top.
Layer the spätzle with the cheese in a buttered dish and let it melt briefly in the oven at 180°C.
Top with the fried onions and chives and serve with salad.

recipes.name: Pfannkuchen (German pancakes)
steps: Mix the flour, eggs, milk, sugar and salt into a smooth batter and leave to stand for 10 minutes.
Heat a little oil in a frying pan.
Add a ladleful of batter, swirl the pan and cook the pancake on both sides until golden.
Keep the finished pancakes warm in the oven at 80°C.
Serve with apple sauce, cinnamon sugar or jam.

recipes.name: Kartoffelpuffer (potato pancakes) with apple sauce
steps: Peel and finely grate the potatoes, then grate the onions in too.
Squeeze the mixture out firmly in a tea towel.
Mix with the eggs, flour, nutmeg, salt and pepper.
Heat plenty of oil, add 1 tbsp of the mixture at a time, flatten it in the pan and fry on both sides until crisp.
Drain on kitchen paper and serve with apple sauce.

recipes.name: Tomato and mozzarella pasta bake
steps: Preheat the oven to 200°C. Cook the pasta for 2 minutes less than the packet says.
Dice the onions and sweat in the oil, add the passata and cream and season.
Halve the cherry tomatoes and mix with the pasta and sauce in an ovenproof dish.
Arrange slices of mozzarella on top.
Bake for about 25 minutes until the cheese is golden brown.

recipes.name: Creamed spinach with fried egg and potatoes
ingredients: 800 g fresh leaf spinach or 600 g frozen creamed spinach
steps: Peel the potatoes and boil in salted water for about 20 minutes.
Dice the onion and garlic and sweat in 1 tbsp butter.
Add the spinach and let it wilt, stir in the cream and season with nutmeg, salt and pepper.
Fry the eggs sunny side up in the remaining butter.
Serve the potatoes with the spinach and fried eggs.

recipes.name: Pan-fried gnocchi with vegetables
ingredients: 150 g feta or soft goat's cheese
steps: Slice the mushrooms, cut the courgette into half-moons and the onion into strips.
Fry the gnocchi in 1 tbsp oil until golden brown and remove.
Fry the vegetables in the remaining oil for about 5 minutes, then add the cherry tomatoes.
Return the gnocchi to the pan and season.
Crumble the cheese over and sprinkle with chives.

recipes.name: Vegetable fried rice
steps: Cook the rice according to the packet instructions and let the steam evaporate.
Dice the peppers and onion and fry in the oil for 5 minutes.
Add the peas and sweetcorn and fry briefly.
Add the rice and fry, then whisk the eggs and stir them into the pan until set.
Season with soy sauce, herb salt and pepper.

recipes.name: Tomato soup with cheese on toast
steps: Dice the onion and sweat in butter until translucent.
Add the tomatoes, tomato juice, stock and sugar and simmer for 15 minutes.
Blend the soup, stir in the cream and season with salt and pepper.
Top the bread with cheese and toast in the oven or a frying pan until golden.
Sprinkle the soup with basil and serve with the cheese on toast.
